description: Class-level progression table and metadata for Barbarian 2024 (source: SRD / WotC).

features.name: Rage
features.description: Enter a rage as a bonus action (not in heavy armor). Gain resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, advantage on Strength checks/saves, and +2 damage on Strength attacks. Lasts until end of your next turn; extend by attacking, forcing a save, or using bonus action. Max 10 minutes. Uses: 2.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier. Shield can be used and benefit retained.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use mastery properties of 2 simple or martial melee weapons of your choice (e.g., Greataxes, Handaxes). Change weapon choices after a long rest.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: On your first attack roll of your turn, gain advantage on Strength-based attacks until start of next turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage during that time.

features.name: Barbarian Subclass
features.description: Choose a Primal Path (Berserker, Wild Heart, World Tree, or Zealot). Grants features at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: Gain proficiency in another Barbarian skill. While raging, can make ability checks with Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival using Strength instead of normal ability.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1. Cannot exceed 20 by this feature.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Subclass Feature (6th)
features.description: Feature granted by your chosen Primal Path.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of the bonus action to enter Rage, move up to half your speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: If using Reckless Attack, forgo advantage on one Strength attack. On hit, deal extra 1d10 damage and apply one Brutal Strike effect: Forceful Blow (push 15 ft) or Hamstring Blow (reduce speed 15 ft).

features.name: Subclass Feature (10th)
features.description: Feature granted by your chosen Primal Path.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: If you drop to 0 HP while raging and don't die, make DC 10 Constitution save. On success, gain HP equal to twice your Barbarian level. DC increases by 5 each use; resets on short or long rest.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: Add Staggering Blow (disadvantage on next save, no opportunity attacks) and Sundering Blow (+5 bonus to next attack against target) to Brutal Strike options.

features.name: Subclass Feature (14th)
features.description: Feature granted by your chosen Primal Path.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: When rolling initiative, regain all Rage uses. Can't do so again until long rest. Rage lasts 10 minutes without extending, ends only if unconscious or wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike (2)
features.description: Extra damage from Brutal Strike increases to 2d10. Can use two different Brutal Strike effects with each use.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check or save is less than your Strength score, use that score instead.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4 (max 25). Unlimited Rage uses.
